name: Entre Voces | Oregon Spanish–English Medical & Legal Interpreter Foundations
scope: original independent-study reference and practice material; NOT an approved training course, certification, assessed professional competence or expert-verified glossary
credentialing_notice: Oregon OHA generally requires approved 60-hour health care interpreter training. A 40-hour interdisciplinary knowledge checkpoint does not meet state certification requirements; court interpreting has a different qualification process.
review_notice: All bilingual term pairs and sample utterances are original, provisional educational drafts pending review by qualified bilingual Oregon medical/legal interpreters and domain professionals. Citations are references for subject matter and training scope; not individual-entry verification.
public_safety: No real patient/client data; simulated utterances. Never offer medical or legal advice. Models may generate candidate assessments but must not claim credentialing or autonomously overrule an ambiguous spoken response.

study_scope.checkpoint_meaning: Learning sequence only. All extension content is an optional reference and advanced practice bank, not material expected to be mastered in forty hours.
study_scope.required_review: Bilingual clinical/legal review, native audio sampling, equity and learner usability testing required before professional training deployment.

assessment_contract.safe_model_policy: The model generates candidate unit-level judgments with cited evidence. Deterministic code validates schema, source links, task eligibility and evidence categories. Never award readiness or credential by model confidence.
assessment_contract.asr_policy: Do not collapse audio recognition errors into interpreting errors; store source audio, ASR hypotheses and transcript disputes separately when permitted.
assessment_contract.progression_policy: Self-rated cards and assisted exercises inform review selection but never count as independent oral performance.
assessment_contract.content_publish_policy: Machine generated content remains draft until qualified bilingual and subject-matter verification; allow safe fictional practice under explicit draft label.

use_in_app.term_drills: Select by category, level, source and direction. Assess recognition separately from oral output.
use_in_app.spoken_reality: Record source and interpretation separately. Require exact preservation of meaning units including numbers, polarity, agency and register. Distinguish ASR error from learner error. Allow indeterminate and dispute.
use_in_app.content_generation: Generate only sourced concepts and safe fictional scenarios. Preserve source id, meaning units and review status. Do not promote auto-generated keys to validated truth.
use_in_app.feedback: User-friendly compare/replay and retry; withhold professional proficiency claims.

concepts.title: Anatomy versus physiology
concepts.explanation_en: Anatomy names structures; physiology explains functions.
concepts.explanation_es: La anatomía nombra estructuras; la fisiología explica sus funciones.
concepts.pitfall: Do not use heart function to define the heart itself.

concepts.title: Symptom versus sign
concepts.explanation_en: A symptom is experienced and described; a sign is observed or measured.
concepts.explanation_es: Un síntoma se experimenta; un signo se observa o se mide.
concepts.pitfall: Fever may be reported by patient or measured by clinician.

concepts.title: Disease versus syndrome
concepts.explanation_en: A disease is a pathological condition; a syndrome is a cluster of findings that can have different causes.
concepts.explanation_es: Una enfermedad es una afección; un síndrome agrupa hallazgos que pueden tener distintas causas.
concepts.pitfall: Do not convert an undiagnosed syndrome into a confirmed disease.

concepts.title: Acute versus chronic
concepts.explanation_en: Acute refers to onset or duration; chronic means persistent or long term.
concepts.explanation_es: Agudo se refiere al inicio o duración; crónico indica persistencia.
concepts.pitfall: Acute does not always mean severe.

concepts.title: Infection versus inflammation
concepts.explanation_en: Infection involves a pathogen; inflammation is a biological response with several possible causes.
concepts.explanation_es: La infección involucra un microorganismo; la inflamación puede tener varias causas.
concepts.pitfall: Do not translate all swelling as infection.

concepts.title: Allergy versus adverse effect
concepts.explanation_en: Allergy is an immune response; other adverse effects may have different mechanisms.
concepts.explanation_es: La alergia es una respuesta inmunitaria; otros efectos adversos no necesariamente lo son.
concepts.pitfall: Do not promote side effect to allergy.

concepts.title: Screening versus diagnostic test
concepts.explanation_en: Screening looks for risk or possible disease; diagnostic testing evaluates a suspected condition.
concepts.explanation_es: El tamizaje detecta posibles problemas; una prueba diagnóstica estudia una sospecha clínica.
concepts.pitfall: A positive screening result is not a definitive diagnosis.

concepts.title: Symptoms as dimensions
concepts.explanation_en: Interpret location, onset, duration, frequency, quality, severity and triggers separately.
concepts.explanation_es: La ubicación, inicio, duración, frecuencia, calidad, intensidad y factores desencadenantes son datos distintos.
concepts.pitfall: A clinician may ask all seven in a row.

concepts.title: Heart attack versus cardiac arrest
concepts.explanation_en: Heart attack is loss of blood supply causing muscle injury; cardiac arrest is loss of effective pumping.
concepts.explanation_es: Un infarto daña el músculo por falta de flujo; un paro es cese de bombeo eficaz.
concepts.pitfall: They can occur together but are not synonyms.

concepts.title: Stroke and colloquial speech
concepts.explanation_en: Accidente cerebrovascular is a technical umbrella term; derrame may imply bleeding in some contexts.
concepts.explanation_es: Accidente cerebrovascular es un término general; derrame puede sugerir hemorragia.
concepts.pitfall: Preserve what was said without inventing a subtype.

concepts.title: Dose, route, frequency and timing
concepts.explanation_en: These are independent medication details; a single wrong number or unit changes the instruction.
concepts.explanation_es: Dosis, vía, frecuencia y horario son datos distintos.
concepts.pitfall: Twice daily is not automatically every twelve hours.

concepts.title: Medication reconciliation
concepts.explanation_en: The clinician compares the current medicines to an existing list.
concepts.explanation_es: Se compara la lista actual de medicamentos con los antecedentes.
concepts.pitfall: Do not silently remove OTC or herbal items.

concepts.title: Consent is a process
concepts.explanation_en: Informed consent requires relevant explanation and an opportunity to decide; interpreter transmits the exchange.
concepts.explanation_es: El consentimiento informado requiere información y oportunidad de decidir; el intérprete transmite el diálogo.
concepts.pitfall: Interpreter should not advise a patient what to choose.

concepts.title: Capacity versus competence
concepts.explanation_en: Decision-making capacity is clinical and task specific; legal competence is established in legal contexts.
concepts.explanation_es: La capacidad de decidir se evalúa para una decisión concreta; la competencia jurídica depende del marco legal.
concepts.pitfall: Do not collapse the terms in psychiatric or probate settings.

concepts.title: Urgency versus emergency
concepts.explanation_en: Urgent care and emergency care are distinct settings; do not infer triage from a translation.
concepts.explanation_es: Atención urgente y atención de emergencia corresponden a niveles distintos.
concepts.pitfall: Interpret the clinician; do not triage yourself.

concepts.title: Physical versus mental health vocabulary
concepts.explanation_en: Terms such as trauma, withdrawal and depression change meaning by context.
concepts.explanation_es: Trauma, abstinencia y depresión pueden cambiar de sentido según el contexto.
concepts.pitfall: Distinguish a speaker's symptom from a diagnosis.

concepts.title: Prenatal, labor and postpartum timeline
concepts.explanation_en: Pregnancy care, childbirth and after-delivery care are sequential but different phases.
concepts.explanation_es: Prenatal, parto y posparto son etapas diferentes.
concepts.pitfall: Labor is trabajo de parto, not trabajo remunerado.

concepts.title: Oregon CCO versus insurer
concepts.explanation_en: CCO is a coordinated provider network for Oregon Health Plan members; coverage decisions have separate processes.
concepts.explanation_es: Una CCO coordina la atención de miembros de OHP; la cobertura se decide mediante procesos específicos.
concepts.pitfall: Do not assume all insurance is OHP.

concepts.title: Interpreting versus translating
concepts.explanation_en: Interpreting transfers spoken or signed discourse; translation handles written text.
concepts.explanation_es: La interpretación transmite mensajes orales o señados; la traducción trata textos escritos.
concepts.pitfall: Sight translation is oral rendering of written text.

concepts.title: Civil versus criminal case
concepts.explanation_en: Criminal action is brought by government over an offense; civil action usually resolves disputes over rights or remedies.
concepts.explanation_es: La acción penal trata delitos; la civil suele resolver derechos o reparaciones.
concepts.pitfall: Plaintiff in civil is not the prosecutor.

concepts.title: Charge versus claim versus complaint
concepts.explanation_en: A criminal charge alleges an offense; a civil claim asserts a legal right; complaint has procedural and everyday meanings.
concepts.explanation_es: Un cargo penal acusa un delito; una reclamación civil afirma un derecho.
concepts.pitfall: Context decides the translation of complaint.

concepts.title: Judgment versus sentence
concepts.explanation_en: Judgment is a formal court decision; criminal sentence is the imposed penalty.
concepts.explanation_es: Un fallo o sentencia decide; la pena es la sanción penal impuesta.
concepts.pitfall: Do not use a grammatical oración for criminal sentence.

concepts.title: Arraignment versus trial
concepts.explanation_en: An arraignment addresses initial charge-related matters; trial takes evidence and determines issues.
concepts.explanation_es: En la lectura de cargos se informan asuntos iniciales; en el juicio se presentan pruebas.
concepts.pitfall: An arraignment does not decide guilt by full trial.

concepts.title: Dismissal versus acquittal
concepts.explanation_en: Dismissal ends a claim or charge; acquittal is a not-guilty determination on a charge.
concepts.explanation_es: La desestimación termina el caso; la absolución resuelve la acusación a favor del acusado.
concepts.pitfall: Do not treat all dismissals as acquittals.

concepts.title: Probation versus parole
concepts.explanation_en: Probation is a court sentence with community conditions; parole concerns release following imprisonment.
concepts.explanation_es: La condena condicional y la libertad pospenitenciaria son procesos diferentes.
concepts.pitfall: Avoid using one Spanish phrase for both without context.

concepts.title: Burden and standard of proof
concepts.explanation_en: Burden identifies who must prove; standard identifies how persuasive evidence must be.
concepts.explanation_es: La carga indica quién prueba; el estándar indica el nivel requerido.
concepts.pitfall: A reasonable doubt standard differs from preponderance.

concepts.title: Objections and judicial rulings
concepts.explanation_en: An objection is raised by counsel; sustained accepts it and overruled rejects it.
concepts.explanation_es: Una objeción la plantea una parte; el juez la admite o la rechaza.
concepts.pitfall: Never invert sustained/overruled.

concepts.title: Discovery versus trial evidence
concepts.explanation_en: Discovery exchanges information before trial; admissibility determines what is usable at trial.
concepts.explanation_es: El intercambio previo de información no equivale a admisión de pruebas en juicio.
concepts.pitfall: A produced document is not necessarily admissible.

concepts.title: Hearsay is technical
concepts.explanation_en: Out-of-court statements raise hearsay issues only under specific rules, purposes and exceptions.
concepts.explanation_es: La prueba de referencia depende de reglas y excepciones.
concepts.pitfall: Do not explain the law while interpreting.

concepts.title: Notice versus summons versus subpoena
concepts.explanation_en: Notice informs; summons orders response or appearance; subpoena compels testimony or production.
concepts.explanation_es: La notificación informa; la citación y el requerimiento imponen obligaciones diferentes.
concepts.pitfall: Do not collapse all into cita.

concepts.title: Service versus filing
concepts.explanation_en: Filing submits papers to court; service delivers required notice to another party.
concepts.explanation_es: Presentar no es lo mismo que notificar a una parte.
concepts.pitfall: The order of events can affect deadline.

concepts.title: Custody has multiple meanings
concepts.explanation_en: Detention custody concerns control of a person; child custody concerns parental responsibility.
concepts.explanation_es: La custodia penal y la custodia de menores se refieren a relaciones distintas.
concepts.pitfall: Do not reuse the same assumptions across domains.

concepts.title: Parenting time versus custody
concepts.explanation_en: Parenting time is scheduled time with child; custody is an allocation of decision-making responsibility.
concepts.explanation_es: El tiempo de crianza no equivale a la custodia.
concepts.pitfall: Oregon-specific distinction deserves practice.

concepts.title: Protective order types
concepts.explanation_en: Different Oregon protective orders have different statutes, grounds and consequences.
concepts.explanation_es: Las distintas órdenes de protección de Oregón tienen requisitos específicos.
concepts.pitfall: Keep FAPA or stalking order name exact when given.

concepts.title: Notice to vacate versus eviction judgment
concepts.explanation_en: A landlord notice is not necessarily a court order for eviction.
concepts.explanation_es: Un aviso de desocupación no equivale por sí solo a una orden judicial de desalojo.
concepts.pitfall: Critical for tenant-facing interpreting.

concepts.title: Immigration jurisdiction
concepts.explanation_en: USCIS and immigration courts generally apply federal law, distinct from Oregon state courts.
concepts.explanation_es: La inmigración se rige principalmente por derecho federal, no estatal.
concepts.pitfall: Do not call an immigration judge an Oregon circuit judge.

concepts.title: Privilege versus confidentiality
concepts.explanation_en: Privilege can bar compelled disclosure of defined communications; confidentiality is broader duty to protect data.
concepts.explanation_es: El privilegio jurídico y la confidencialidad no son idénticos.
concepts.pitfall: Do not improvise privilege advice.

concepts.title: Legal interpretation preserves register
concepts.explanation_en: Hesitations, slang, vulgarity, honorifics and uncertainty may matter as evidence.
concepts.explanation_es: Las vacilaciones, expresiones y dudas pueden importar jurídicamente.
concepts.pitfall: Do not turn tentative testimony into certainty.

concepts.title: Deadlines, inclusive words and conditions
concepts.explanation_en: At least, no more than, unless, within and on or before each control different legal boundaries.
concepts.explanation_es: Por lo menos, no más de, salvo, dentro de y a más tardar cambian el alcance.
concepts.pitfall: A single reversed condition changes rights.

concepts.title: Consecutive mode and chunking
concepts.explanation_en: Listen to a complete short unit, preserve meaning, then reproduce in the other language.
concepts.explanation_es: Escuche una unidad completa, conserve su sentido y transmítala en el otro idioma.
concepts.pitfall: Do not wait so long that critical numbers are lost.

concepts.title: Simultaneous exposure
concepts.explanation_en: Listen and render nearly at the same time while maintaining a lag appropriate to meaning.
concepts.explanation_es: Escuche y transmita casi simultáneamente con un desfase adecuado.
concepts.pitfall: High cognitive load; not a shortcut for a 40-hour learner.

concepts.title: Sight translation
concepts.explanation_en: Read a short written document and orally render it faithfully in the other language.
concepts.explanation_es: Lea el texto escrito y transmítalo oralmente al otro idioma.
concepts.pitfall: Use only in permitted assignment context.

concepts.title: First person and complete message
concepts.explanation_en: Interpret in the speaker's voice and preserve assertions, questions, corrections and tone.
concepts.explanation_es: Interprete en la voz del hablante y conserve preguntas, correcciones y tono.
concepts.pitfall: Avoid he said/she said additions.

concepts.title: Transparent error correction
concepts.explanation_en: When interpreter notices an error, disclose and correct the record transparently.
concepts.explanation_es: Si detecta un error, comuníquelo y corríjalo de forma transparente.
concepts.pitfall: Never secretly edit previous testimony or treatment instructions.

concepts.title: Handling unknown terminology
concepts.explanation_en: Ask for clarification, spellings or repeats rather than inventing equivalents.
concepts.explanation_es: Pida aclaraciones o repeticiones en vez de inventar términos.
concepts.pitfall: A model should mark indeterminate if evidence is weak.

concepts.title: Speaker identity and pronouns
concepts.explanation_en: Preserve who did what to whom and who is being addressed.
concepts.explanation_es: Conserve el agente, el receptor y las referencias personales.
concepts.pitfall: Gender and pronoun assumptions can materially alter meaning.

concepts.title: Numbers and negation as critical units
concepts.explanation_en: Numbers, dates, durations, conditional language and polarity must be retained.
concepts.explanation_es: Cifras, fechas, plazos, condiciones y negaciones se deben conservar.
concepts.pitfall: Fatal dosage and legal-deadline mistakes originate here.

concepts.title: Dialect recognition without stereotype
concepts.explanation_en: A regional term may have multiple senses; ask rather than assuming identity or proficiency.
concepts.explanation_es: Un regionalismo puede tener varios sentidos; aclare sin suponer identidad.
concepts.pitfall: Social background is not diagnostic of language level.

concepts.title: Interpreter boundaries
concepts.explanation_en: Interpreter conveys meaning and identifies barriers; clinicians and attorneys make substantive decisions.
concepts.explanation_es: El intérprete comunica y señala impedimentos; el profesional decide.
concepts.pitfall: No medical or legal advice.

concepts.title: Triage is not diagnosis
concepts.explanation_en: Triage prioritizes urgency; a symptom description alone is not a diagnosis.
concepts.explanation_es: El triaje prioriza la urgencia; describir un síntoma no constituye un diagnóstico.
concepts.pitfall: An interpreter must not decide the urgency level.

concepts.title: Patient report versus chart finding
concepts.explanation_en: A patient's words, clinician's observation and historical chart data are separate evidence sources.
concepts.explanation_es: Las palabras del paciente, las observaciones clínicas y el historial son fuentes distintas.
concepts.pitfall: Do not resolve a contradiction silently.

concepts.title: Therapy versus prevention
concepts.explanation_en: A prophylactic measure aims to prevent a condition; treatment addresses an existing concern.
concepts.explanation_es: La profilaxis busca prevenir; el tratamiento aborda una afección existente.
concepts.pitfall: Do not invent a condition from a preventive medicine.

concepts.title: Question versus instruction
concepts.explanation_en: A clinician's conditional question about symptoms is not an instruction or final diagnosis.
concepts.explanation_es: Una pregunta clínica condicional no es una instrucción ni diagnóstico.
concepts.pitfall: Preserve interrogative form.

concepts.title: Pain scale is self-report
concepts.explanation_en: A reported pain rating is a subjective patient assessment, not an objective diagnosis.
concepts.explanation_es: La escala de dolor refleja la experiencia declarada del paciente.
concepts.pitfall: Preserve exact rating and range.

concepts.title: Treatment adherence versus access barrier
concepts.explanation_en: Missing a dose because of cost differs from intentional refusal.
concepts.explanation_es: No tomar una dosis por falta de recursos no equivale a rechazar el tratamiento.
concepts.pitfall: Preserve explanation and avoid blame.

concepts.title: Test pending versus test negative
concepts.explanation_en: A pending result has not been determined; a negative result has been reported.
concepts.explanation_es: Un resultado pendiente no equivale a uno negativo.
concepts.pitfall: Clinical implications differ.

concepts.title: Sensitivity and specificity
concepts.explanation_en: A test's ability to detect conditions and exclude noncases are separate properties.
concepts.explanation_es: La sensibilidad y la especificidad describen propiedades diferentes de una prueba.
concepts.pitfall: Avoid asserting that positive means certainty.

concepts.title: Radiation and imaging
concepts.explanation_en: CT typically uses X-rays; MRI relies on magnetic fields and radio waves.
concepts.explanation_es: La tomografía suele usar rayos X; la resonancia emplea campos magnéticos y ondas de radio.
concepts.pitfall: The procedures are not synonyms.

concepts.title: Biopsy and pathology
concepts.explanation_en: A biopsy obtains tissue; pathology analyzes samples and reports findings.
concepts.explanation_es: La biopsia obtiene tejido; patología estudia muestras y emite resultados.
concepts.pitfall: A planned biopsy is not proof of cancer.

concepts.title: Benign and malignant language
concepts.explanation_en: An abnormal result, a suspicious finding and a malignancy diagnosis have different certainty.
concepts.explanation_es: Hallazgo anormal, sospecha y diagnóstico maligno expresan distinta certeza.
concepts.pitfall: No promotion of suspected disease to confirmed disease.

concepts.title: Medication list completeness
concepts.explanation_en: Prescription, OTC, vitamins and herbs may all be relevant when a clinician asks what is taken.
concepts.explanation_es: Se deben distinguir medicamentos recetados, de venta libre, vitaminas y hierbas.
concepts.pitfall: Do not omit volunteered substances.

concepts.title: Clinical interpreter and cultural explanation
concepts.explanation_en: Interpreters may signal cultural or linguistic misunderstandings transparently within professional boundaries.
concepts.explanation_es: Los intérpretes pueden señalar malentendidos culturales o lingüísticos con transparencia.
concepts.pitfall: No personal clinical advice.

concepts.title: Patient autonomy and informed refusal
concepts.explanation_en: A patient can ask questions, accept or decline a proposed procedure according to context.
concepts.explanation_es: La persona puede preguntar, aceptar o rechazar un procedimiento según el contexto.
concepts.pitfall: Don't rephrase refusal as noncompliance.

concepts.title: OHP and language service access
concepts.explanation_en: Coverage terminology, interpreter access and eligibility decisions are different functions.
concepts.explanation_es: Cobertura, acceso a interpretación y decisión de elegibilidad son funciones diferentes.
concepts.pitfall: Do not promise coverage.

concepts.title: Allegation and evidentiary status
concepts.explanation_en: A pleading states claims; the filing itself does not establish that the claims are true.
concepts.explanation_es: Un escrito plantea afirmaciones; presentarlo no las convierte en hechos probados.
concepts.pitfall: Preserve alleged and reportedly.

concepts.title: First appearance versus contested hearing
concepts.explanation_en: A first appearance often handles preliminary matters; a later contested hearing may address disputes.
concepts.explanation_es: La comparecencia inicial aborda asuntos preliminares; otra audiencia puede resolver controversias.
concepts.pitfall: Do not claim every hearing is a trial.

concepts.title: Legal representation and court staff
concepts.explanation_en: An attorney gives legal advice; court staff may provide information but not counsel.
concepts.explanation_es: Un abogado asesora jurídicamente; el personal judicial puede brindar información.
concepts.pitfall: The interpreter gives neither legal advice nor procedural recommendations.

concepts.title: Plea and allocution
concepts.explanation_en: A plea responds to charges; allocution refers to a defendant's opportunity to address the court in sentencing.
concepts.explanation_es: La declaración ante cargos y la intervención al dictar la pena tienen propósitos diferentes.
concepts.pitfall: Preserve speaker and stage.

concepts.title: Objection grounds and ruling
concepts.explanation_en: An objection has a legal basis; the judge's ruling accepts or rejects it.
concepts.explanation_es: Una objeción plantea un fundamento; el tribunal la admite o la rechaza.
concepts.pitfall: Overruled and sustained cannot be reversed.

concepts.title: Conditions versus exceptions
concepts.explanation_en: Unless expresses an exception; until expresses a time boundary; subject to can express a condition.
concepts.explanation_es: A menos que, hasta que y sujeto a expresan relaciones distintas.
concepts.pitfall: Conditions affect obligations.

concepts.title: Civil remedies and criminal penalties
concepts.explanation_en: Damages, injunctions and restitution may serve different roles from a criminal sentence.
concepts.explanation_es: Indemnización, orden judicial y restitución pueden tener funciones distintas de una pena.
concepts.pitfall: Do not assume damages always means physical harm.

concepts.title: Oregon eviction progression
concepts.explanation_en: Notice, filing, first appearance, answer, trial and judgment are distinguishable events.
concepts.explanation_es: Aviso, presentación de demanda, comparecencia, contestación, juicio y fallo son hechos distintos.
concepts.pitfall: Specific process varies by case and date.

concepts.title: Family proceedings and child-related roles
concepts.explanation_en: Legal custody, parenting time, guardianship and child support involve separate concepts.
concepts.explanation_es: Custodia legal, tiempo de crianza, tutela y pensión alimenticia son distintos.
concepts.pitfall: Avoid assuming gendered parenting arrangements.

concepts.title: Protection orders are not interchangeable
concepts.explanation_en: FAPA, stalking and other protection pathways may have different legal tests.
concepts.explanation_es: Las distintas órdenes de protección responden a marcos legales diferentes.
concepts.pitfall: Do not reduce all to restraining order.

concepts.title: Immigration proceedings and state matters
concepts.explanation_en: Federal immigration proceedings do not automatically determine a state court's ruling.
concepts.explanation_es: El procedimiento migratorio federal no equivale a un asunto estatal.
concepts.pitfall: Keep agencies and court roles distinct.

concepts.title: Civil burden and criminal standard
concepts.explanation_en: Different case types may apply different proof thresholds.
concepts.explanation_es: La carga y el estándar de prueba pueden variar según el asunto.
concepts.pitfall: Do not import beyond-a-reasonable-doubt language into every civil case.

concepts.title: Memory chunking follows meaning
concepts.explanation_en: Segment speech by coherent units while retaining relationships across sentences.
concepts.explanation_es: Divida el discurso en unidades de sentido sin perder sus relaciones.
concepts.pitfall: Do not split a negative from the verb it qualifies.

concepts.title: Meaning before synonym matching
concepts.explanation_en: Several equivalent renderings may work, but an elegant phrase can still omit the key fact.
concepts.explanation_es: Puede haber varias expresiones correctas; una versión elegante puede omitir un hecho esencial.
concepts.pitfall: Rubrics must judge facts, not string similarity.

concepts.title: ASR uncertainty is a separate error class
concepts.explanation_en: A transcript can mishear an accent, name, number or negation even when the spoken answer was correct.
concepts.explanation_es: Un sistema de reconocimiento puede oír mal una cifra o negación aunque la respuesta oral fuera correcta.
concepts.pitfall: Allow replay, dispute and unscored outcome.

concepts.title: Dialect variation without essentializing
concepts.explanation_en: Regional or family expressions can have multiple meanings within the same community.
concepts.explanation_es: Las expresiones regionales o familiares pueden variar dentro de una comunidad.
concepts.pitfall: Do not assign meaning from ethnicity or age alone.

concepts.title: Self-repair must be audible
concepts.explanation_en: When a speaker or interpreter corrects a statement, the correction should be represented transparently.
concepts.explanation_es: Al corregir una declaración, la corrección debe comunicarse de forma transparente.
concepts.pitfall: Silent polishing changes the record.

concepts.title: Training scaffolds are not proficiency
concepts.explanation_en: Recognition, supported speech, independent oral interpretation and professional readiness are different milestones.
concepts.explanation_es: Reconocimiento, producción guiada, interpretación independiente y habilitación profesional son etapas distintas.
concepts.pitfall: Self-reported knowledge is not a license.

drills.source_text: I have been short of breath since yesterday, but I have not had chest pain.
drills.reference_rendering: Me falta el aire desde ayer, pero no he tenido dolor en el pecho.

drills.source_text: Me empezó el dolor ayer a las siete, pero hoy se me corre hacia el brazo izquierdo.
drills.reference_rendering: The pain started yesterday at seven, but today it spreads toward my left arm.

drills.source_text: Take one tablet by mouth twice a day with food for seven days.
drills.reference_rendering: Tome una tableta por vía oral dos veces al día con alimentos durante siete días.

drills.source_text: Me tomo dos pastillas cuando me acuerdo, no cada doce horas.
drills.reference_rendering: I take two pills when I remember, not every twelve hours.

drills.source_text: She has a family history of diabetes but has never been diagnosed herself.
drills.reference_rendering: Ella tiene antecedentes familiares de diabetes, pero nunca ha recibido ese diagnóstico.

drills.source_text: A veces me mareo al levantarme, pero nunca me he desmayado.
drills.reference_rendering: Sometimes I get dizzy when I stand up, but I have never fainted.

drills.source_text: The screening test was positive; we need another test to confirm what it means.
drills.reference_rendering: La prueba de detección salió positiva; necesitamos otra prueba para confirmar qué significa.

drills.source_text: Me dijeron que el resultado fue negativo, pero sigo con fiebre.
drills.reference_rendering: They told me the result was negative, but I still have a fever.

drills.source_text: If you have trouble breathing or your lips turn blue, seek emergency help immediately.
drills.reference_rendering: Si tiene dificultad para respirar o se le ponen azules los labios, busque ayuda de emergencia de inmediato.

drills.source_text: No quiero hablar de eso frente a mi pareja; prefiero que me pregunten a solas.
drills.reference_rendering: I do not want to talk about that in front of my partner; I would rather be asked in private.

drills.source_text: Your coordinated care organization can explain how to schedule an interpreter at no cost to you.
drills.reference_rendering: Su organización de atención coordinada puede explicarle cómo programar un intérprete sin costo para usted.

drills.source_text: Tengo cobertura del Plan de Salud de Oregón, pero todavía no sé cuál es mi CCO.
drills.reference_rendering: I have Oregon Health Plan coverage, but I still do not know which CCO I have.

drills.source_text: The CT scan was ordered to investigate the headache; it is not the same as an MRI.
drills.reference_rendering: Se pidió una tomografía para investigar el dolor de cabeza; no es lo mismo que una resonancia magnética.

drills.source_text: Tengo doce semanas de embarazo y todavía no he tenido mi primera consulta prenatal.
drills.reference_rendering: I am twelve weeks pregnant and have not yet had my first prenatal visit.

drills.source_text: When you say you feel hopeless, are you having thoughts of ending your life?
drills.reference_rendering: Cuando dice que siente que no hay esperanza, ¿está pensando en quitarse la vida?

drills.source_text: No tengo un plan para hacerme daño, pero sí he pensado que sería mejor no despertar.
drills.reference_rendering: I do not have a plan to harm myself, but I have thought it might be better not to wake up.

drills.source_text: You may ask questions before deciding whether to consent; you do not have to decide right now.
drills.reference_rendering: Puede hacer preguntas antes de decidir si da su consentimiento; no tiene que decidir ahora mismo.

drills.source_text: Me dieron de alta ayer, pero hoy me salió una secreción de la herida.
drills.reference_rendering: I was discharged yesterday, but today discharge came from the wound.

drills.source_text: You are charged with a misdemeanor. This hearing is not your trial.
drills.reference_rendering: Se le acusa de un delito menor. Esta audiencia no es su juicio.

drills.source_text: Yo entendí que debo presentarme el martes, no el jueves.
drills.reference_rendering: I understood that I have to appear on Tuesday, not Thursday.

drills.source_text: I think I saw a blue car, but I am not certain it was the defendant's.
drills.reference_rendering: Creo que vi un automóvil azul, pero no estoy seguro de que fuera del acusado.

drills.source_text: No lo vi entrar; escuché que alguien dijo que había entrado.
drills.reference_rendering: I did not see him enter; I heard someone say that he had entered.

drills.source_text: I said about fifteen minutes, not exactly fifteen minutes.
drills.reference_rendering: Dije unos quince minutos, no exactamente quince minutos.

drills.source_text: Yo estaba ahí, pues, como a eso de las once y pico, creo.
drills.reference_rendering: I was there, um, at around eleven-something, I think.

drills.source_text: Objection, hearsay. Sustained. The jury will disregard that answer.
drills.reference_rendering: Objeción, testimonio de oídas. Se admite la objeción. El jurado no tomará en cuenta esa respuesta.

drills.source_text: Objeción, su señoría. Se rechaza la objeción. Puede contestar.
drills.reference_rendering: Objection, Your Honor. Overruled. You may answer.

drills.source_text: Probation is not the same as parole, and you must comply with the conditions in this order.
drills.reference_rendering: La condena condicional no es lo mismo que la libertad condicional pospenitenciaria, y debe cumplir las condiciones de esta orden.

drills.source_text: No me declaré culpable; mi abogado pidió que se aplazara la audiencia.
drills.reference_rendering: I did not plead guilty; my attorney asked that the hearing be postponed.

drills.source_text: The order addresses parenting time, but it does not change legal custody.
drills.reference_rendering: La orden se refiere al tiempo de crianza, pero no modifica la custodia legal.

drills.source_text: El juez cambió el horario de visitas, no la pensión alimenticia.
drills.reference_rendering: The judge changed the visitation schedule, not the child support.

drills.source_text: This notice to vacate is not, by itself, a court eviction judgment.
drills.reference_rendering: Este aviso para desocupar no es, por sí solo, una sentencia judicial de desalojo.

drills.source_text: Pagué el depósito de garantía, pero todavía no he firmado el contrato de arrendamiento.
drills.reference_rendering: I paid the security deposit, but I have not yet signed the lease.

drills.source_text: File your response on or before November sixth; this is not a hearing date.
drills.reference_rendering: Presente su contestación a más tardar el seis de noviembre; no es una fecha de audiencia.

drills.source_text: Le entregué la notificación al arrendatario, pero todavía no presenté la demanda ante el tribunal.
drills.reference_rendering: I delivered the notice to the tenant, but I have not yet filed the complaint with the court.

drills.source_text: You may speak with your attorney before deciding whether to answer that question.
drills.reference_rendering: Puede hablar con su abogado antes de decidir si contesta esa pregunta.

drills.source_text: No renuncio a mi derecho a guardar silencio.
drills.reference_rendering: I am not waiving my right to remain silent.

drills.source_text: An administrative appeal is different from an appeal of a criminal conviction.
drills.reference_rendering: Una apelación administrativa es distinta de una apelación de una condena penal.

drills.source_text: No entendí si la audiencia es por teléfono o en persona; ¿me lo pueden repetir?
drills.reference_rendering: I did not understand whether the hearing is by phone or in person; could you repeat that?

drills.source_text: I stopped taking the medicine three days ago because it made me dizzy, but I have not told my doctor.
drills.reference_rendering: Dejé de tomar el medicamento hace tres días porque me mareaba, pero no se lo he dicho a mi médico.

drills.source_text: Me dijeron media pastilla al día, no una pastilla cada medio día.
drills.reference_rendering: They told me half a pill a day, not one pill every half day.
required_meaning_units: NOT one tablet every half day

drills.source_text: The pain comes and goes, mostly after meals, and I have not vomited.
drills.reference_rendering: El dolor aparece y desaparece, principalmente después de comer, y no he vomitado.

drills.source_text: No es que me falte fuerza; es que se me duerme la mano izquierda a ratos.
drills.reference_rendering: It is not that I lack strength; my left hand goes numb at times.

drills.source_text: The result is still pending, so please do not assume it is negative.
drills.reference_rendering: El resultado todavía está pendiente, así que por favor no suponga que es negativo.

drills.source_text: Me salió elevado el azúcar, según el papel, pero no sé si eso significa diabetes.
drills.reference_rendering: My blood sugar was high, according to the paper, but I do not know if that means diabetes.

drills.source_text: We ordered an MRI, not a CT scan, and the appointment is next Thursday.
drills.reference_rendering: Pedimos una resonancia magnética, no una tomografía, y la cita es el próximo jueves.

drills.source_text: La biopsia está programada, pero nadie me ha dicho que tenga cáncer.
drills.reference_rendering: The biopsy is scheduled, but nobody has told me I have cancer.

drills.source_text: Have you ever had a rash or trouble breathing after taking this drug?
drills.reference_rendering: ¿Alguna vez ha tenido sarpullido o dificultad para respirar después de tomar este medicamento?

drills.source_text: No me dio alergia, nomás me cayó pesado al estómago, creo.
drills.reference_rendering: It did not cause an allergy; it just upset my stomach, I think.

drills.source_text: The nurse will assess you first; I cannot tell you how long the wait will be.
drills.reference_rendering: La enfermera lo evaluará primero; no puedo decirle cuánto tendrá que esperar.

drills.source_text: Lo que me preocupa es que hoy sí me falta el aire, aunque ayer no.
drills.reference_rendering: What worries me is that today I am short of breath, although yesterday I was not.

drills.source_text: Please let us know which language you prefer for medical discussions and whether you need an interpreter.
drills.reference_rendering: Díganos qué idioma prefiere para hablar de su atención médica y si necesita un intérprete.

drills.source_text: No quiero que mi nieto me traduzca estas preguntas; prefiero un intérprete profesional.
drills.reference_rendering: I do not want my grandson to interpret these questions; I prefer a professional interpreter.

drills.source_text: The ultrasound estimate is eighteen weeks, plus or minus several days.
drills.reference_rendering: La ecografía estima dieciocho semanas, con un margen de varios días.

drills.source_text: No he tenido contracciones, pero sí una presión rara desde anoche.
drills.reference_rendering: I have not had contractions, but I have had an unusual pressure since last night.

drills.source_text: I want to ask a difficult question. Have you thought about hurting yourself, even if you have no plan?
drills.reference_rendering: Quiero hacerle una pregunta difícil. ¿Ha pensado en hacerse daño, aunque no tenga un plan?

drills.source_text: No dije que lo fuera a hacer; dije que a veces me da miedo pensarlo.
drills.reference_rendering: I did not say I would do it; I said that sometimes I am afraid of thinking about it.

drills.source_text: Call the clinic if the redness spreads, but seek emergency care if you have trouble breathing.
drills.reference_rendering: Llame a la clínica si el enrojecimiento se extiende, pero busque atención de emergencia si tiene dificultad para respirar.

drills.source_text: Me dieron de alta el viernes; el sábado empezó a salir líquido de la herida.
drills.reference_rendering: I was discharged on Friday; on Saturday fluid started coming out of the wound.

drills.source_text: This is your first appearance; the trial has not been scheduled yet.
drills.reference_rendering: Esta es su comparecencia inicial; todavía no se ha programado el juicio.

drills.source_text: Me citaron para el martes, pero la carta llegó hasta el miércoles anterior.
drills.reference_rendering: I was summoned for Tuesday, but the letter did not arrive until the previous Wednesday.

drills.source_text: I might have seen him leave, but the streetlight was not working.
drills.reference_rendering: Puede que lo haya visto salir, pero el alumbrado de la calle no funcionaba.

drills.source_text: Mi vecina dice que lo vio; yo solamente escuché un portazo.
drills.reference_rendering: My neighbor says she saw him; I only heard a door slam.

drills.source_text: Correction: I said the fifteenth, but I meant the fifth.
drills.reference_rendering: Corrección: dije el día quince, pero quise decir el cinco.

drills.source_text: No, perdón, no fue a las tres. Fue como a las tres y media, más o menos.
drills.reference_rendering: No, sorry, it was not at three. It was around three thirty, approximately.

drills.source_text: The objection is overruled. The witness may answer the question.
drills.reference_rendering: Se rechaza la objeción. El testigo puede contestar la pregunta.

drills.source_text: Se admite la objeción; no conteste esa pregunta todavía.
drills.reference_rendering: The objection is sustained; do not answer that question yet.

drills.source_text: A plea of not guilty is not the same as a finding of innocence.
drills.reference_rendering: Declararse no culpable no equivale a una determinación de inocencia.

drills.source_text: No acepté ningún acuerdo; pedí tiempo para hablar con mi abogada.
drills.reference_rendering: I did not accept any agreement; I asked for time to speak with my attorney.

drills.source_text: The revised parenting schedule starts in December, but legal custody remains unchanged.
drills.reference_rendering: El horario modificado de tiempo de crianza comienza en diciembre, pero la custodia legal no cambia.

drills.source_text: La jueza habló de la custodia, no del pago de manutención; eso quedó pendiente.
drills.reference_rendering: The judge spoke about custody, not support payments; that remains pending.

drills.source_text: A notice from a landlord does not necessarily mean that an eviction judgment has been entered.
drills.reference_rendering: Un aviso del arrendador no necesariamente significa que ya se haya dictado una sentencia de desalojo.

drills.source_text: Me dieron un aviso para desocupar, pero aún no he recibido ninguna citación judicial.
drills.reference_rendering: They gave me a notice to vacate, but I have not received any court summons yet.

drills.source_text: The complaint was filed on Monday, but the defendant has not been served.
drills.reference_rendering: La demanda se presentó el lunes, pero aún no se ha notificado al demandado.

drills.source_text: Presenté mi contestación ayer; no estoy diciendo que el juez ya decidió.
drills.reference_rendering: I filed my answer yesterday; I am not saying the judge has already ruled.

drills.source_text: This is a temporary order. The hearing to consider a longer order is next week.
drills.reference_rendering: Esta es una orden temporal. La audiencia para considerar una orden más duradera es la próxima semana.

drills.source_text: Lo que pido es que me aclaren a quién se aplica esa prohibición, no que me den asesoría legal.
drills.reference_rendering: I am asking you to clarify whom that prohibition applies to, not to give me legal advice.

drills.source_text: The employee reports forty-six hours worked but says the pay stub shows forty.
drills.reference_rendering: La empleada dice haber trabajado cuarenta y seis horas, pero señala que el talón de pago muestra cuarenta.

drills.source_text: No digo que me despidieron; digo que me bajaron las horas sin avisar.
drills.reference_rendering: I am not saying I was fired; I am saying they reduced my hours without notice.

ethics_decisions.situation: A provider says a word the interpreter does not know.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Disclose the interpreting difficulty and request clarification; do not invent a term.
ethics_decisions.reason: An invented term could misstate care instructions.

ethics_decisions.situation: The patient's sister offers to interpret while a qualified interpreter is available.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Use approved language-access arrangements; do not presume family interpretation is sufficient.
ethics_decisions.reason: Confidentiality, accuracy and role boundaries.

ethics_decisions.situation: A clinician asks the interpreter to explain which treatment the patient should choose.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Interpret the clinician's explanation and patient's questions; do not choose for patient.
ethics_decisions.reason: Informed decisions are for patient and clinician.

ethics_decisions.situation: The patient uses an unfamiliar regional expression for a symptom.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Ask for clarification and accurately relay response.
ethics_decisions.reason: Dialect is not a reliable basis for guessing diagnosis.

ethics_decisions.situation: The interpreter realizes they reversed a medicine frequency.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Interrupt transparently and correct the interpreted message immediately.
ethics_decisions.reason: Medication frequency is a critical meaning unit.

ethics_decisions.situation: The speaker says three tablets, but the prescription image shows two.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Interpret the spoken words and transparently flag a need for clarification rather than silently harmonizing.
ethics_decisions.reason: Record and speech conflict can matter.

ethics_decisions.situation: A user asks the AI trainer for personalized medication instructions.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Redirect to clinician; present terminology practice only.
ethics_decisions.reason: The trainer is not a treatment authority.

ethics_decisions.situation: A learner's speech recognition transcript omits a negation.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Mark the attempt indeterminate and offer audio review/correction.
ethics_decisions.reason: Speech recognition error cannot be equated with interpreting error.

ethics_decisions.situation: Witness uses rough slang and repetitions.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Preserve voice and content including meaningful slang and hesitation.
ethics_decisions.reason: Polishing testimony changes evidence.

ethics_decisions.situation: Interpreter recognizes a party from a family relationship.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Disclose potential conflict to the appropriate court authority.
ethics_decisions.reason: Impartiality and perceived bias matter.

ethics_decisions.situation: Judge issues an instruction before interpreter finishes.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Request permission to complete the utterance; maintain transparency.
ethics_decisions.reason: Omission is prohibited by accuracy requirement.

ethics_decisions.situation: Defendant asks interpreter whether to accept a plea.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Do not provide legal advice; facilitate attorney-client communication.
ethics_decisions.reason: Interpreter is not defense counsel.

ethics_decisions.situation: Interpreter is asked to summarize a lengthy witness answer.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Request manageable segments; do not replace complete interpretation with summary.
ethics_decisions.reason: Legal testimony requires completeness.

ethics_decisions.situation: Court uses a statutory term unfamiliar to the interpreter.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: State limitation and request clarification or replacement when needed.
ethics_decisions.reason: No invented legal equivalence.

ethics_decisions.situation: Interpreter hears a second interpreter render a different date.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Raise concern transparently through the appropriate channel and verify exact date.
ethics_decisions.reason: Calendar differences affect rights.

ethics_decisions.situation: AI model is uncertain whether a response preserves a legal condition.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Withhold automatic mastery credit and route to reviewed reference/clarification.
ethics_decisions.reason: An ungrounded confidence score is unsafe.

ethics_decisions.situation: A patient's accent makes speech recognition display a different dosage.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Replay original audio and offer transcript correction before any scoring decision.
ethics_decisions.reason: A transcription defect is not an interpreting defect.

ethics_decisions.situation: An AI declares a patient's euphemism a confirmed cancer diagnosis.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Mark as unsupported; seek clarification of the original statement.
ethics_decisions.reason: A colloquial phrase is not a diagnostic result.

ethics_decisions.situation: A family member demands access to private answers during sensitive screening.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Maintain boundaries and request authorized process for privacy and professional interpretation.
ethics_decisions.reason: Relationship alone does not authorize disclosure.

ethics_decisions.situation: The interpreter hears what sounds like fifteen instead of fifty milligrams.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Request immediate repetition before transmitting the amount.
ethics_decisions.reason: Numbers in medication instructions are safety critical.

ethics_decisions.situation: An appointment note and spoken clinician instruction conflict on fasting time.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Transmit each statement as spoken and flag the inconsistency transparently.
ethics_decisions.reason: Never silently choose the answer that appears reasonable.

ethics_decisions.situation: A clinician uses an acronym that could mean two things.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Ask for expansion in context rather than assume the familiar meaning.
ethics_decisions.reason: Acronyms often collide across specialties.

ethics_decisions.situation: A patient says no me hallo and the system labels it depression.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Request contextual clarification and preserve the expression without diagnosis.
ethics_decisions.reason: Colloquial distress language is context dependent.

ethics_decisions.situation: A learner completes five multiple-choice medication items correctly.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Record terminology recognition only, not ability to interpret medication counseling.
ethics_decisions.reason: Recognition is weaker evidence than unscripted oral production.

ethics_decisions.situation: A learner provides a correct oral answer but automatic transcript drops no.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Offer a no-penalty review and do not treat the missing negative as learner failure.
ethics_decisions.reason: ASR uncertainty must remain separate.

ethics_decisions.situation: The interpreter is asked to suggest a safer treatment.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Interpret the question to the clinician and decline personal treatment advice.
ethics_decisions.reason: Clinical decision belongs to authorized professionals.

ethics_decisions.situation: A defendant asks the court interpreter whether to plead guilty.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Do not recommend a plea; facilitate direct communication with counsel.
ethics_decisions.reason: This is legal advice outside interpreter role.

ethics_decisions.situation: A witness says I guess but the AI omits uncertainty in the model answer.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Preserve the uncertainty and flag the reference answer for review.
ethics_decisions.reason: Court testimony requires fidelity to qualification.

ethics_decisions.situation: The court says sustained but a practice answer says overruled.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Reject the inverted meaning and explain the two distinct rulings.
ethics_decisions.reason: This reverses the judicial instruction.

ethics_decisions.situation: A speaker retracts an answer after a question.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Interpret the original and the retraction; do not simply overwrite the record.
ethics_decisions.reason: Self-correction is part of courtroom testimony.

ethics_decisions.situation: A tenant receives an eviction notice and asks if they have already lost in court.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Do not decide legal status; accurately distinguish the notice from a judgment and direct legal questions to counsel.
ethics_decisions.reason: Interpreter must not give case-specific advice.

ethics_decisions.situation: One side asks the interpreter to share the opposing party's confidential statement.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Maintain professional confidentiality and report pressure through proper channels.
ethics_decisions.reason: Interpreter must remain impartial.

ethics_decisions.situation: A court term matches a common word but has a narrower statutory meaning.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Keep the specialized sense when supported and request clarification if uncertain.
ethics_decisions.reason: False friends can alter legal relationships.

ethics_decisions.situation: A generated scenario asserts a specific Oregon deadline without current rule citation.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Reject publication until current primary law or form is verified.
ethics_decisions.reason: Court deadlines and forms change.

ethics_decisions.situation: A learner passes flashcards about custody and parenting time.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Do not infer ability to interpret a contested family hearing.
ethics_decisions.reason: Knowledge recognition is not live interpreting competence.

ethics_decisions.situation: The interpreter does not hear which party the judge addressed.
ethics_decisions.preferred_action: Request repetition of the addressee before interpreting.
ethics_decisions.reason: Pronoun and speaker errors can reverse responsibilities.

contrasts.critical_distinction: Do not collapse the patient's distinct sensory descriptors into pain alone.
Vertigo suggests a spinning sensation; fainting is loss of consciousness; a vague mareo requires context.
Loss of strength, tiredness and reduced sensation are distinct observations.

contrasts.spanish_pair: prueba de detección vs prueba diagnóstica
contrasts.critical_distinction: A screening result alone is not a confirmed condition.
Result polarity matters, but whether positive is good or bad depends on the test.

contrasts.contrast_en: allergy vs intolerance vs side effect
contrasts.spanish_pair: alergia vs intolerancia vs efecto secundario
contrasts.critical_distinction: Never promote reported nausea into a confirmed immune allergy.
A 500-mg tablet and a prescribed number of tablets are different information.
Twice per day does not automatically mean exactly every 12 hours.

contrasts.spanish_pair: resurtido o renovación vs receta nueva
contrasts.critical_distinction: Refilling an existing prescription is not the same as authorizing a new medicine.

contrasts.contrast_en: discharge from hospital vs wound discharge
contrasts.spanish_pair: alta hospitalaria vs secreción de una herida
contrasts.critical_distinction: The same English word has unrelated clinical senses.

contrasts.spanish_pair: trabajo de parto vs trabajo remunerado
contrasts.critical_distinction: Do not hear labor and assume employment in obstetrics.

contrasts.spanish_pair: inducción vs estimulación del trabajo de parto
contrasts.critical_distinction: Starting labor and strengthening ongoing labor are not identical.
Do not infer pregnancy or uterine labor without context.

contrasts.spanish_pair: pérdida espontánea del embarazo vs interrupción voluntaria
contrasts.critical_distinction: Avoid moral assumptions and preserve speaker's terms and context.
Do not treat colloquial derrame as proof of bleeding subtype.

contrasts.spanish_pair: paro cardíaco vs infarto de miocardio
contrasts.critical_distinction: Loss of effective pumping and injury due to reduced blood flow differ.
Inflammation does not necessarily imply a microorganism.
A lesion can be benign without being harmless in every situation.
Chronic describes duration; terminal suggests a prognosis.
One is commonly clinical and decision-specific; the other may be legal.

contrasts.spanish_pair: cuidados paliativos vs cuidados de hospicio
contrasts.critical_distinction: Palliative services are not necessarily only for the final stage of life.
Never decide a diagnosis from a colloquial expression.
Presence or absence of a plan is not interchangeable with thoughts.

contrasts.spanish_pair: Plan de Salud de Oregón vs organización de atención coordinada
contrasts.critical_distinction: A state coverage program and a coordinating organization are not identical.
A supportive family member is not automatically a qualified interpreter.
An accusation is not a finding of guilt.
An arrest is not a criminal conviction.
A defendant's response and fact-finder's decision differ.
They can end a case for different reasons and must not merge.
Local practice and exact financial mechanism determine equivalence.

contrasts.spanish_pair: condena condicional o probación vs libertad pospenitenciaria
contrasts.critical_distinction: Probation and post-incarceration supervision are distinct systems.

dialogues.learning_purpose: A patient is uncertain about a changed dose

turns.speaker: Clinician
turns.text: The chart lists one tablet every morning. What are you actually taking?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Pues, tomo dos si me duele mucho, pero ayer no tomé ninguna.

turns.speaker: Clinician
turns.text: Do you mean two at once or one twice a day?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Dos juntas, pero no todos los días. ¿Eso está mal?

turns.speaker: Nurse
turns.text: Did the shortness of breath begin before or after the chest pressure?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Primero la presión, como a las ocho. Lo del aire vino después, no sé a qué hora.

turns.speaker: Nurse
turns.text: Did you lose consciousness at any point?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No, nunca. Sí me sentí como que me iba a desmayar.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Preserve screening uncertainty and next steps

turns.speaker: Physician
turns.text: The screening test suggests a possible problem; it is not a diagnosis.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Entonces, ¿ya tengo la enfermedad o todavía no se sabe?

turns.speaker: Physician
turns.text: We cannot confirm it from this test. We will discuss another test with you.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No quiero decidir hoy. Quiero hacer preguntas primero.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Distinguish coverage, network and language access

turns.speaker: Scheduler
turns.text: Are you an Oregon Health Plan member, and do you know your coordinated care organization?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Tengo OHP, pero no sé qué organización me asignaron.

turns.speaker: Scheduler
turns.text: We can check the next step. Do you need an interpreter for the appointment?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Sí, en español, y prefiero que no interprete mi hija.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Distinguish passive thought, plan and privacy

turns.speaker: Clinician
turns.text: When you said you sometimes wish not to wake up, have you made any plan to harm yourself?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No tengo ningún plan. A veces sí pienso que todos estarían mejor sin mí.

turns.speaker: Clinician
turns.text: Thank you for telling me. Is there someone you feel safe talking to?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: No quiero hablarlo frente a mi pareja. ¿Podemos hacerlo a solas?

turns.speaker: Midwife
turns.text: How many weeks pregnant are you, and when was your last prenatal visit?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Creo que diecisiete semanas. Todavía no me han hecho una ecografía.

turns.speaker: Midwife
turns.text: Do you mean you have not had any ultrasound during this pregnancy?

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Exacto. Y desde anoche tengo dolor, pero no he sangrado.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Preserve speaker choice without interpreter advice

turns.speaker: Surgeon
turns.text: You may ask questions before deciding. The consent form does not obligate you to proceed today.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Necesito que me expliquen el riesgo de infección. Todavía no voy a firmar.

turns.speaker: Surgeon
turns.text: Let's go through the risks and alternatives one at a time.

turns.speaker: Patient
turns.text: Gracias. No quiero que decidan por mí.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Maintain allegation vs conviction and calendaring

turns.speaker: Judge
turns.text: You are charged with a misdemeanor. You have not been convicted by this court.

turns.speaker: Defendant
turns.text: Entonces, ¿hoy no es el juicio? No entiendo la diferencia.

turns.speaker: Judge
turns.text: Today's hearing addresses the charge and scheduling. It is not a trial.

turns.speaker: Defendant
turns.text: Entiendo. Quiero hablar con mi defensor antes de contestar.

turns.speaker: Attorney
turns.text: Did you see the person enter the apartment or did someone tell you?

turns.speaker: Witness
turns.text: Me dijeron que entró. No, espere, lo que vi fue el coche afuera.

turns.speaker: Attorney
turns.text: So you did not personally see anyone enter?

turns.speaker: Witness
turns.text: Exacto. Nunca dije que lo viera entrar.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: This notice is not a court judgment. Has the landlord filed an eviction case?

turns.speaker: Tenant
turns.text: Me entregaron un aviso el lunes, pero no he recibido papeles del tribunal.

turns.speaker: Clerk
turns.text: I can explain where court forms are available, but cannot advise you how to defend the case.

turns.speaker: Tenant
turns.text: ¿Dónde puedo encontrar información sobre asistencia legal?

turns.speaker: Judge
turns.text: The order changes parenting time only. It does not change legal custody or child support.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: ¿Entonces los domingos serán diferentes pero la custodia sigue igual?

turns.speaker: Judge
turns.text: The revised schedule is in the written order. Please ask your attorney any legal questions.

turns.speaker: Parent
turns.text: Quiero que me repitan la hora exacta porque escuché seis y no siete.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Stay precise about type and respondent

turns.speaker: Judge
turns.text: This hearing concerns a Family Abuse Prevention Act order, not a criminal trial.

turns.speaker: Petitioner
turns.text: Quiero saber si la orden temporal sigue vigente hasta que se decida el caso.

turns.speaker: Judge
turns.text: I will address that issue in this hearing. Do you have a question about the document?

turns.speaker: Petitioner
turns.text: Sí. Necesito que aclaren a quién se aplica la condición de no contacto.

turns.speaker: Investigator
turns.text: What hours do you say you worked last week, and which hours were paid?

turns.speaker: Worker
turns.text: Trabajé cuarenta y seis, según mi cuenta. Me pagaron cuarenta, creo.

turns.speaker: Investigator
turns.text: Do you have a time record or pay stub we can compare?

turns.speaker: Worker
turns.text: Tengo el talón de pago, pero no apunté todas las horas.

dialogues.learning_purpose: Separate federal agencies and Oregon court roles

turns.speaker: Advisor
turns.text: USCIS is a federal agency. It is not the Oregon circuit court hearing your family matter.

turns.speaker: Person
turns.text: Mi carta viene de USCIS; mi audiencia de familia es en el tribunal estatal.

turns.speaker: Advisor
turns.text: These are separate proceedings. Please refer legal questions to the relevant representative.

turns.speaker: Person
turns.text: ¿Me puede repetir cuál documento debo llevar a cada cita?

dialogues.learning_purpose: Model transparent correction, not silent rewrite

turns.speaker: Speaker
turns.text: I took two pills on Thursday, not Tuesday.

turns.speaker: Interpreter
turns.text: Interpreté martes por error. Corrijo mi interpretación: la persona dijo jueves, no martes.

turns.speaker: Speaker
turns.text: Yes, Thursday. I am certain of that day.

turns.speaker: Interpreter
turns.text: El hablante confirma que fue el jueves y que está seguro de ese día.

competencies.title: Professional neutrality
competencies.observable_goal: Separate interpreter words from the speakers; avoid advice, additions and role switching.

competencies.title: Confidentiality and conflicts
competencies.observable_goal: Identify potential conflicts and protect private information according to setting.

competencies.title: Transparent clarification and repair
competencies.observable_goal: Interrupt appropriately, request repetition and correct interpreted errors openly.

competencies.title: Active listening and working memory
competencies.observable_goal: Retain idea groups and recover numbers after short unprepared speech.

competencies.title: Pronouns and agency
competencies.observable_goal: Preserve speaker, recipient, obligation and referents.

competencies.title: Negation and uncertainty
competencies.observable_goal: Preserve not, never, not yet, likely, maybe, approximate and conditional language.

competencies.title: Clinical concept recognition
competencies.observable_goal: Distinguish body systems, symptoms, signs, tests and procedures.

competencies.title: Medication and measurement safety
competencies.observable_goal: Preserve dose, route, unit, interval and timing without inference.

competencies.title: Sensitive health encounter
competencies.observable_goal: Preserve the patient's voice, autonomy and privacy requests.

competencies.title: Oregon health system orientation
competencies.observable_goal: Distinguish OHP, CCO, interpreter scheduling and coverage language.

competencies.title: Court roles and chronology
competencies.observable_goal: Recognize who speaks, procedural phase and document types.

competencies.title: Criminal-law distinctions
competencies.observable_goal: Distinguish allegations, pleas, rulings, proofs, rights and outcomes.

competencies.title: Testimony and evidence fidelity
competencies.observable_goal: Preserve hearsay, retractions, register and courtroom directives.

competencies.title: Oregon civil/family/housing scope
competencies.observable_goal: Distinguish parenting time, custody, support, notices and judgments.

competencies.title: Source-grounded research
competencies.observable_goal: Look up official dates, scope, institutional sources and variants.

competencies.title: Bidirectional oral consecutive
competencies.observable_goal: Render short spoken turns in both directions without prompting or answer choices.

competencies.title: Sight rendering
competencies.observable_goal: Render short procedural/health passages orally from written source text.

competencies.title: Recognition vs performance distinction
competencies.observable_goal: Track multiple-choice recognition separately from independent spoken production.

curriculum.title: Professional role, ethics and scope
curriculum.outcome: Explain accuracy, impartiality, confidentiality, role boundaries and transparent interventions.
curriculum.exercises: Compare healthcare vs court codes; role-play conflict and unknown-term disclosures.

curriculum.title: Listening, memory, delivery and modes
curriculum.outcome: Produce faithful first-person consecutive segments; experience sight and simultaneous.
curriculum.exercises: Numbers, negation, colloquialisms, register, note-taking, self-repair.

curriculum.title: Anatomy, symptoms and medical histories
curriculum.outcome: Identify body systems, symptom dimensions and history-taking distinctions.
curriculum.exercises: Short oral histories and patient colloquialisms; explain red-flag meaning without clinical advice.

curriculum.title: Diagnostics, medicines and patient safety
curriculum.outcome: Preserve medication amount, route, frequency, timing, units, uncertainties and tests.
curriculum.exercises: Interpret medication counseling and simple test explanations with correction drills.

curriculum.title: Sensitive care, emergencies and health access
curriculum.outcome: Navigate reproductive/mental health and Oregon health-plan language precisely.
curriculum.exercises: Practice respectful tone, urgent-intent distinctions and CCO access scenarios.

curriculum.title: Oregon courts, roles and proceedings
curriculum.outcome: Recognize parties, filings, hearings, documents and court hierarchy.
curriculum.exercises: Trace civil vs criminal case pathway; interpret a short scheduling hearing.

curriculum.title: Criminal cases, evidence and rights
curriculum.outcome: Keep charge/plea/proof standard/objection and rights distinct.
curriculum.exercises: Work on testimony, hesitation, negation, legal thresholds and spoken objection responses.

curriculum.title: Civil, family, housing and administrative
curriculum.outcome: Interpret core civil remedies, parenting-time differences and notice terminology.
curriculum.exercises: Case maps; compare eviction notice with court judgment; family-court language.

curriculum.title: Research, regional variants and source verification
curriculum.outcome: Look up terminology, date documents, separate institutions and dialects.
curriculum.exercises: Build two mini glossaries with a primary source and alternate Spanish phrasing.

curriculum.title: Integrated oral and written capstone
curriculum.outcome: Demonstrate safe, complete interpretation and identify unsupported areas.
curriculum.exercises: Bidirectional recorded medical and legal scenarios, sight translation, self-audit.
